name: accessibility_check
description: Run the Accessibility Checker's full check (32 rules in 7 categories: document, page_content, forms, alternate_text, tables, lists, headings). Each rule is passed, failed (with findings and pages), manual (needs a person) or skipped. Colour contrast is off unless all is true; rules (ids such as tagged-pdf, figures-alt-text) or categories narrow the check; pages limit the page rules.

all.description: Include rules that are off by default (colour contrast).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers for the page rules (default: all).
